name: hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3_q648

job.purpose: HBM-MC3 structural fix of the native-audit hold (bw_p540_v6: 202 drivers >32 endpoints, ~190 reset; 9 nets >405 um: pc_id_q 441..500 um, reset landing 413 um). RST_FOREST=1: ot_rst_forest s0 -> 8 l1 -> 192 l2 KEPT reset copies (same 3 release edges as ot_rst_relay, 5 with the face landing) + ot_rst_copies synthesis pass (reset_relay_split max_loads 28: every reset load re-pointed over the 192 leaves in name-local groups = per bank / bank group / slice); synchronous resets on the reset family made asynchronous (ring/skid/ready_seen/k_rdy_q/fault_detail: one endpoint per flop); PCID_LOCAL=1 kept per-use pc_id copies + pc_id pins moved E->N beside k_addr. 0 data cycles added; face_txn edges_safe 166921 unchanged.

pin_regs.reason: Every port is a flop D/Q in RTL (L2H-BW SAFE face): K pure capture (k_v 22 pure region D pins, kp_* captures), k_rdy=k_rdy_q, KR skid head flops on the native RL1 ABI, kr_rdy 18 pure region D pins, OREG PHY output flops, RREG PHY return capture, registered pc_fault; tool wrappers would add a second stage and break the RL1 contract.
